4.  **Orlhurst Works**: 95/unit (≤140), 14 days (>6). Fails.
5.  **Lunnick Outfitters**: 35/unit (≤140), 9 days (>6). Fails.
6.  **Kelby Traders**: 105/unit (≤140), 2 days (≤6), 4/10 (<6). Fails.
7.  **Zelton Works**: 70/unit (≤140), 8 days (>6). Fails.
8.  **Calton Traders**: 15/unit (≤140), 15 days (>6). Fails.
